newsitem.title: USA: Dreams Inc halts new franchise sales.
newsitem.headline: Dreams Inc halts new franchise sales.

text.p: Dreams Inc said Sunday it had suspended the sale of new franchises using the Field of Dreams trademark as it negotiated the termination of its license agreement with MCA/Universal Merchandising Inc.

Dreams, which uses the Field of Dreams name in its corporate and franchise sports memorabilia business, said it in a statement it had received from MCA/Universal "a notice of breach and termination" of its license agreement.

"Both companies have agreed that the termination of the license is in suspense pending negotiation," it said. "The suspension ... is pending negotiation of a wind-down period and resolution of accounting issues."
MCA/Universal Merchandising Inc is owned by Seagram Co Ltd.
